title: Casper and the Promise
author: Ada Villalobos
blurb: Vesper Thackeray, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
